indicator.subject: Mathematics
indicator.content_standard: 1.1.4.1 Develop an understanding of decimals (tenths and hundredths) using concrete and pictorial representations and write decimal fractions as base ten numbers with place value.
indicator.objective: Describe and represent decimals (tenths and hundredths) concretely, pictorially, olically

skills.description: Identify decimals representing tenths and hundredths from pictures or models.
Write decimal fractions (tenths and hundredths) as decimals and vice versa.
Identify the value of digits in the tenths and hundredths places.

spec.difficultyPlan: 20 questions: 5 at difficulty 1, 7 at difficulty 2, 5 at difficulty 3, 3 at difficulty 4.
misconceptions: Confusing the tenths and hundredths places.

questions.stem: Which decimal represents 3 tenths?
hints: Tenths mean 1 out of 10 equal parts.
The first place after the decimal point is tenths.

questions.stem: How do you write 7/10 as a decimal?
hints: There is one digit after the decimal point.

questions.stem: In the number 0.45, what digit is in the tenths place?
hints: The tenths place is the first digit after the decimal.
Look at the digit right after the dot.
questions.explanation: The digit in the tenths place is 4.

questions.stem: Write 25 hundredths as a decimal.
hints: Hundredths have two digits after the decimal.
Write 25 with a decimal point in front.

questions.stem: Which fraction is equal to 0.9?
What is the value of the digit 5 in the number 0.52?
hints: The 5 is in the tenths place.
questions.explanation: The 5 is in the tenths place, so its value is 5/10 or 0.5.

questions.stem: A 100-square grid has 23 squares shaded. What decimal represents the shaded part?
Which decimal represents 8 hundredths?
In the number 1.76, what is the value of the digit 6?
hints: The 6 is in the hundredths place.
questions.explanation: The 6 is in the hundredths place, so its value is 0.06.

questions.stem: Write 4/100 as a decimal.
A pupil shades 5 out of 10 equal parts of a rectangle. What decimal is shaded?
In the number 2.34, what is the value of the digit 3? Write as a fraction.
hints: The 3 is in the tenths place.

questions.stem: Which decimal is larger: 0.7 or 0.65?
questions.misconception: Thinking 0.65 is larger because it has more digits.

questions.stem: How do you write '1 and 5 tenths' as a decimal?
Write 12/100 as a decimal.
Explain how to use a place value chart to write 3/10 as a decimal.
questions.explanation: Since the denominator is 10, the 3 goes in the tenths place, which is the first place after the decimal point. So, 3/10 = 0.3.

criteria.description: Mentions placing 3 in the tenths place.

questions.stem: In the number 12.34, what is the value of the digit 4?
hints: The 4 is in the hundredths place.

questions.stem: A pupil says 0.25 is greater than 0.5 because 25 > 5. What is the correct comparison?
hints: Think about the whole. 0.5 is half.
Which is larger, a half or a quarter?
questions.explanation: 0.5 is equal to 1/2 (half), while 0.25 is 1/4 (a quarter). Half is larger than a quarter.
questions.misconception: Thinking a longer decimal is always larger.

questions.stem: Explain the difference between 0.5 and 0.05 using a place value chart.
questions.explanation: In 0.5, the 5 is in the tenths place, meaning 5 out of 10. In 0.05, the 5 is in the hundredths place, meaning 5 out of 100. 0.5 is ten times larger than 0.05.
questions.misconception: Thinking they are the same value just written differently.

questions.stem: Which decimal is equal to 3/100?
hints: 100 in the denominator means two decimal places.
